subject: Post-call exec recap & next steps - Vertex Systems
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@vertexsystems.com>, Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@vertexsystems.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 11:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call exec recap & next steps - Vertex Systems

Tom / Samantha —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick executive recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned with leadership and procurement.

Summary of what we heard (pain / goals)
- Inference cost unpredictability at peak (30–45% overspend) impacting product margins.
- Latency variability causing session timeouts for interactive features (esp. EU region).
- Need for private deployment options and stronger audit evidence for regulated customers.
- Desire to future-proof model routing (multi-cloud + fallback) and avoid vendor lock-in.

Business outcomes Vertex leadership cares about
- Reduce per-request inference cost by ~30–40% through batching/quantization and routing policies.
- Achieve predictable 99.9% API availability for customer-facing features.
- Maintain data residency controls and provide audit artifacts to satisfy enterprise buyers.

Procurement path / timing discussed
- Legal & procurement review followed by PO is the expected path. Samantha confirmed procurement will own the PO.
- Tentative procurement target: PO by mid-June (we discussed June 15).

Open risks / escalation items
- SOC 2 / security evidence: Vertex procurement will need SOC 2 report + supplementary architecture diagrams.
- Data residency: need confirmation on regional isolation options for EU data.
- SLA exceptions for onboarding period (we proposed a 30-day ramp with monitoring).

Action items / next steps (ownership & ETA)
1) Redwood to share t-shirt pricing + detailed unit economics worksheet — Marissa / Aditya — by EOD 2026-05-24.
2) Redwood to share SOC 2 report and high-level deployment diagram — Marissa — by 2026-05-24.
3) Draft SOW and deployment milestones for Dedicated/Private options — Vivek / Legal — draft by 2026-05-24.
4) Schedule procurement + technical sync (proposed window: week of June 1) — Marissa to propose 2 slots.

Please confirm that I captured the items correctly and that the PO timeline still looks reasonable from your side. If you prefer, I can loop in our Head of Reliability for the technical/deployment discussion.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0127

Attachments referenced: redwood-pricing-quote-vertexsystems.xlsx (pricing worksheet), redwood-soc2-report-2025.pdf (SOC 2), draft-sow-vertexsystems.docx (SOW template)

From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@vertexsystems.com>

Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 15:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call exec recap & next steps - Vertex Systems

Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. High level confirmation from my side: I am the executive sponsor on this engagement and will support the procurement path. Samantha is procurement lead for the PO. Timeline is aggressive but possible (we’d like to aim for PO by June 15).

A few clarifications / asks:
- Please include an explicit line-item for our expected monthly committed capacity and an option for burst capacity in the quote.
- We will need the SOC 2 report and a brief write-up on how logs/audit trails are retained and exported (for our auditors).
- Data residency: we need confirmation that EU traffic and KV caches can be isolated to our EU tenancy; if there’s a gap we’ll need mitigation language.

If you can get the pricing worksheet and SOC 2 doc over by Monday (5/24) that will let our procurement/legal start the review. I’ll plan a short sync with Samantha + Marissa once we’ve reviewed the materials.

On escalation: if audit items look incomplete, we may need to route to our security review board — I’ll raise that only if needed.

Tom Reynolds
CFO, Vertex Systems
